sentence: This project builds a system that lets people ask a plain question about sensors and have the computer work out how to answer it.
This project holds a conference to explore how to check that results in materials science can be repeated by others.
This project buys and sets up a computing system for heavy calculations and artificial intelligence research.
This project studies how strongly interacting quantum systems behave by looking at symmetry and at defects that interrupt a uniform system.
This project builds a smart roadside camera that tracks vehicles in real time to help study traffic and road safety.
This project tries to find out which nutrients and microorganisms keep the floating mats of Sargassum seaweed growing across the Atlantic Ocean.
This project builds a tool that creates a miniature Internet inside a personal computer for safely trying out cybersecurity attacks and defenses.
This project tests different ways to write down graphs so that computer models that learn from graph data can handle more kinds of problems.
This project studies which species of tiny algae live in the Arctic Ocean and how they respond to changing temperature, light and competition.
This project tests whether communities of microbes from soils and the human gut balance power and efficiency in the way machines do.
This project builds an open-source platform for learning how to write secure software with artificial intelligence coding tools.
This project tries to grow saffron-like plant tissue from Crocus sativus cells in the lab using a scaffold and a hydrogel.
This project builds computer methods that predict the 3D shapes a protein takes as it folds into its final form.
This project adds computational biology courses and builds a platform of software tools and cloud resources for analyzing images from biology research.
This project studies how deep learning affects decisions in transit systems and builds models that connect predictions directly to decisions.
This project tries to find out how nanoparticles that respond to enzymes interact with an enzyme, using particles that mimic a protein called histone.
